verses.en: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
verses.sm: Levina o ae ma Serupapelu. Levi na o ae faatasi ma Serupapelu le atalii o Salatielu, ma Iosua; o Seraia, o Ieremia, o Esera, o Amaria, o Maluka, o Hatusa, o Sekania,

verses.en: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
verses.sm: o Rekuma, o Meremota,

verses.en: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
verses.sm: o Itu, o Gineto, o Avia,

verses.en: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,
verses.sm: o Meamina, o Maatia, o Pileka,

verses.en: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
verses.sm: o Semaia, ma Ioaripa,

verses.en: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,
verses.sm: o Ietaia, o Salu, o Amoka, o Hilikia,

verses.en: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
verses.sm: ma letaia. O matai ia o faitaulaga ma o latou uso i ona aso 0 Iosua. O sa Levi foi; o Iosua, o Pinui, o Katameeli,

verses.en: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.
verses.sm: o Serepea, o Iuta, ma Matania, o le na pule i le faafetai, o ia ma ona uso. O Pakepuka foi ma Uni, o latou uso, sa faafeagai ma i latou i leoleoga.

verses.en: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.
verses.sm: Na fanaua e Iosua o Ioiakima, na fanaua foi e Ioiakima O Eliasipa,

verses.en: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,
verses.sm: na fanaua foi e Eliasipa o Ioata, na fanaua foi e Ioata o Ionatana, na fanaua e Ionatana O latua.

verses.en: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.
verses.sm: Sa i ai foi i ona po o Ioiakima o faitaulaga,

verses.en: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
verses.sm: o matai sili; o Meraia, o lo sa Seraia; o Hanania, o lo sa Ieremia; o Mesulama, o lo sa Eserá; o Ioanana o lo sa Amaria;

verses.en: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
verses.sm: o Ionatana, o lo sa Melika; o Josefa,

verses.en: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
verses.sm: o lo sa Sepaniá; O Atena, o lo sa Harima;

verses.en: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
verses.sm: O Helekia, o lo sa Meraiotà; o Sakaria,

verses.en: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
verses.sm: o lo sa Ito; o Mesulama, o lo sa Ginetonú;

verses.en: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
verses.sm: o Sekeri, o lo sa Avia; o Piletai, o lo sa Meneamina, o lo sa Moatia;

verses.en: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
verses.sm: o Samua, o lo sa Pileká; o Ionatana, o lo sa Semaia;

verses.en: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
verses.sm: o Matenai foi, o lo sa Ioaripà; o Usi o lo sa Ietaia;

verses.en: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
verses.sm: o Kalai, o lo sa Salai; o Eperu, o lo sa Amoka;

verses.en: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.
verses.sm: o Hasapeia, o lo sa Hilikia; o Natanielu, o lo sa Ietaia.

verses.en: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.sm: O ona po o Eliasipa, ma Ioata, ma loanana, ma latua, na tusia ai o sa Levi o matai sili; atoa ma faitaulaga, e 00 i le malo o Tariu le Peresia.

verses.en: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
verses.sm: Sa tusia i le tusi o tala i nofoaiga, o atalii o Levi, o matai sili, e oo i ona po o Ioanana o le atalii o Eliasipa.

verses.en: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.
verses.sm: O matai foi o sa Levi; o Hasapeia, o Serepea, ma Iosua le atalii o Katameeli, ma o latou uso e faafeagai, e vivii ma faafetai, e tusa ma le poloaiga a Tavita le tagata o le Atua, e auauai i leoleoga.

verses.en: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.
verses.sm: O Matania, ma Pakepuka, o Opetaia, o Mesulama, o Talemoni, ma Akopa, o leoleo faitotoa i latou na leoleo i faaputuga mea i faitotoa.

verses.en: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
verses.sm: Sa i ai i latou i ona po o Ioiakima le atalii o Iosua, o le atalii ia o Iosataka. ma ona po o Neemia le alii e pule, ma Esera le faitaulaga, le tusiupu.

verses.en: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
verses.sm: O le faasaina foi o le pa o Ierusalema ua latou sailia sa Levi i o iatou aai uma, e au mai ia te i latou i Ierusalema, e fai le faasaina o le pa ma le fiafia, ma faafetai, ma pese, ma sumepalo, ma napeli, ma kitara.

verses.en: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;
verses.sm: Ua faapotopoto mai foi le fanauga a e pepese, ai le fanua laugatasi e siosioina ai lerusalema, mai faoa aai foi o Netopa;

verses.en: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.
verses.sm: ma Petekilikala, ma fanua o Kipea, ma Asemau; a4a na fala E pepese mo i latou o faos aai sa faataaliolio i Ierusalema.

verses.en: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
verses.sm: O faitaulaga ma sa Levi na faamama i latou ia te i latou, na latou faamama foi i le nuu, ma faitotoa, ma le pa.

verses.en: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:
verses.sm: Ona ou aveina ae lea o alii o luta i luga o le pa, ma ou tofia vasega tetele e lua o e faafetai; na savavali foi le tasi vasega i le itu taumatau i luga o le pa, e oo i le faitotoa o le otaota;

verses.en: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
verses.sm: na mulimuli atu foi ia te i latou o Hosaia, ma le tasi vaega o alii o Iuta,

verses.en: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
verses.sm: ma Asaria, o Esera, ma Mesulama,

verses.en: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
verses.sm: O Iuta, ma Peniamina, ma Semaia, ma leremia.

verses.en: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:
verses.sm: O isi atalii foi o faitaulaga ua i ai pu; o Sakaria le atalii o Ionatana, o le atalii ia o Semaia, o le atalii ia o Matania, o le atalii ia o Mekaia, o le atalii ia o Sakura, o le atalii ia o Asafo;

verses.en: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.
verses.sm: ma ona uso, o Semaia, ma Asareelu, o Melali, o Kilali, o Maai, o Natanielu, ma Iuta, ma Hanani, ua i ai laaupese a Tavita le tagata o le Atua, ma Esera le tusiupu i o latou luma.

verses.en: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.
verses.sm: O le faitotoa foi o le vaipuna, sa i o latou luma, na latou o ae ai i le ala faaapefai o le aai o Tavita, i le alu ae o le pa, ilugao le fale o Tavita, e oo atu lava ile faitotoa o le vai i sasae.

verses.en: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;
verses.sm: O lona lua foi o vasega o e na faafetai ua latou savavali i le tasi itu, ua ou mulimuli atu foi ia te i latou, ma le tasi vaega o le nuu i luga o le pa, e afua i ona tala atu O le ‘olo o ogaumu e oo atu i le pa lautele;

verses.en: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.
verses.sm: mai luga foi o le faitotoa O Efaraima, ma luga o le faitotoa tuai, ma luga o le faitotoa o iʻa, ma le ‘olo o Hananiali, ma le “olo o Meaa, e oo lava i le faitotoa o mamoe; ma ua latou tutú i le faitotoa o le fale puipui.

verses.en: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:
verses.sm: Ona tutú ai lea o vasega e lua o e faafetai i le fale o le Atua, o aʻu foi, ma le tasi vaega O faipule faatasi ma au;

verses.en: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
verses.sm: ma faitaulaga; o Eliakimo, o Maaseia, o Meneamina, o Mekaia, o Elioenai, o Sakaria, ma Hanania, ua i ai pu;

verses.en: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
verses.sm: ma Maaseia, ma Semaia, ma Eleasara, ma Usi, ma Ioanana, ma Malekia, ma Elama, ma Esera. Ua pepese foi ma le leo tele o e pepese, ma Isaraia lo latou matai.

verses.en: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
verses.sm: Ua latou osia foi i lea aso o taulaga e tele, ma ua latou fiafia; aua ua faafiafia le Awa ia te i latou i le fiafia tele; o fafine foi ma tama na latou fiafia; ua lagona foi le fiafia o Ierusalema i mea e mamao atu.

verses.en: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.
verses.sm: Sa tofia foi i lea aso nisi e pule i potu e tuu ai oloa, ma taulaga, ma mea faapolopolo, ma mea e sefulu aЧ mea, e faapotopoto i ai mai fanua o aai o mea e tusa ma le tulafono ma faitaulaga ma sa Levi; aua na fiafia Iuta ona o faitaulaga ma sa Levi o e na tutù mai.

verses.en: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
verses.sm: O e pepese foi atoa ma leoleo faitotoa, na latou tausiusi i le tofiga a lo latou Atua, ma le tofiga o le faamamàina, e tusa ma le poloaiga a Tavita, ma Solomona lona atalii.

verses.en: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
verses.sm: Auà talu anamua i ona po o Tavita ma Asafo sa i ai matai o e pepese pese, ma pese e vivii ai ma faafetai i le Atua.

verses.en: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.
verses.sm: Na avane foi e Isaraelu uma i ona po o Serupapelu, ma ona po o Neemia o tufaaga a è pepese ma leoleo faitotoa, o le aso ma lana mea; ma latou faasaina mea e sefulu ai mea má sa Levi; ua faasaina foi e sa Levi o mea e sefulu aЧ mea ma le fanauga a Arona.
